what: When is a second, expensive attacker worth running at all?
why: A model Challenger costs minutes where the scripted one costs about two seconds. Escalating everywhere is not a design, it is a bill. This measures how selective the policy actually is on the shipped corpus.
policy: Escalate only where the scripted attacker returned PASS and the environment declares fewer than 5 trivial policies, so the silence is thin evidence rather than a saturated floor.
harness: uv run --extra adapters --extra openenv --extra tau2 python scripts/escalation_policy.py
